tutorial.welcome: Guide Building: Welcome! Your starting capital is ready.
tutorial.modes: 🎮 Solo: on your own. Multiplayer: with friends via room link + 4-digit PIN. Online: coming soon.
tutorial.s1: 1) Click an empty shop and found your company (solo founder).
tutorial.s1b: 💡 Short on money? Start cheap at the Digital Plaza with a home office, virtual office or e-office, or rent a coworking desk.
tutorial.s2: 2) You can join another company as co-founder, employee or customer.
tutorial.s2b: 🎁 Working at a company with benefits (transport, insurance, meals) boosts your performance and experience.
tutorial.s3: 3) Click your shop to make sales (idle clicker).
tutorial.s4: 4) Every game day, rent, electricity, salaries and benefits are deducted; watch your revenue.
tutorial.s5: 5) Watch out for NPC events: customers, investors, sponsors... but also thieves and scammers!
tutorial.s6: 6) Write your idea in the Idea Box. Audio/video ideas unlock with Premium.
tutorial.s5b: ⚠️ Crises: concordat, trustee, government pressure, political attack, war, cyber attack. Bigger companies are bigger targets; NPCs can go bankrupt too!

r1.line: Hi! I've heard great things about {{product}}. Why should I choose you?
r1.o1: Welcome! Let me hear what you need first, then we'll pick the best fit together.
r1.o2: Because it's good quality and everyone likes it; I think it's right for you.
r1.o3: Honestly I need to hit my target today, so buying now would really help me.

r2.line: Could you suggest something to go with it? My budget is fine.
r2.o1: Sure, we have matching items, let me show you the list.
r2.o2: That's enough, you don't need anything more.
r2.o3: Depending on how you'll use it I'd suggest two add-ons, and I won't push what you don't need.

r3.line: Looks great. What about delivery and after-sales support?
r3.o1: I don't know about delivery right now, we'll look into it later.
r3.o2: We deliver fast and have a line you can call anytime; call me and I'll handle it.
r3.o3: There's delivery and there's support, don't worry.

r1.line: I have no time! Will {{product}} do the job? Be quick.
r1.o1: In short: it's a good, solid product.
r1.o2: Three sentences: fast, sturdy, delivered right away. Tell me what you need and we'll pick the right one.
r1.o3: Don't rush, I'll walk you through every feature from the start.

r2.line: What's the price? Give me one number, don't drag it out.
r2.o1: {{price}}, fixed. If you like, we can sort it out in one go.
r2.o2: Prices vary by case, let me check...
r2.o3: It's on the price list, around {{price}}.

r3.line: Okay, how do I pay and when do I get it?
r3.o1: You need to fill in a few forms first, it takes a while.
r3.o2: You can pay at the till.
r3.o3: Pay by card right now and take it with you; you're out in two minutes.

r1.line: {{price}} for {{product}} is a bit expensive, isn't it? I saw it cheaper elsewhere.
r1.o1: That's the price, no bargaining. Take it or leave it.
r1.o2: You're right, but its quality makes it cheaper in the long run. Let me show you why it's worth it.
r1.o3: You're right, price matters. But our product is reliable.

r2.line: Is there a warranty or a return policy? I don't want to waste my money.
r2.o1: There's usually no problem, don't worry.
r2.o2: I don't know the warranty details, I'd have to check.
r2.o3: Yes, if you're not happy you can return it; I take the risk.

r3.line: I'm thinking... tell me something that convinces me to buy.
r3.o1: I've suggested the best option for your needs; the decision is yours and I'm here for you.
r3.o2: Stock is limited, I'd buy today.
r3.o3: Other customers are waiting, let me know when you decide.

r1.line: Everyone says that. Does {{product}} really work?
r1.o1: Of course it works, trust me.
r1.o2: If you don't like it, don't buy it, nobody is forcing you.
r1.o3: You're right to doubt. Let me show you customer reviews and examples of use, and you decide.

r2.line: So what's the downside? Every product has a flaw.
r2.o1: It has no flaws, it's a perfect product.
r2.o2: To be honest: it has limits in some cases, but not for the way you'd use it.
r2.o3: There may be small things, but they don't matter.

r3.line: Do you have references? Can I talk to people who bought it?
r3.o1: Yes, I can share the views of two happy customers; then you decide.
r3.o2: Giving references is against company policy.
r3.o3: Lots of people around here use it, you can ask.

found.q: How do I start a company?
found.a: Enter an empty shop or the Digital Plaza, pick a workspace (home office is cheapest), then set a product and price. Low on money? Start with a home office or virtual office.
found.kw: company start found create business startup founder shop plaza office home

sell.a: Open your company's Sales department and click 'Sell'. Use 🗣 'Talk to a customer' to persuade a customer for a bigger sale. Price, level and performance raise earnings.
sell.kw: sell sales click customer money earn income revenue product price

hire.a: Use the HR department to hire NPC staff or make another player an employee or partner. Perks raise performance; salaries are paid daily.
hire.kw: hire employee staff worker fire salary hr partner cofounder perks

money.a: The Finance tab shows income, expenses and profit. If cash goes negative, invest; if it is high, withdraw profit. Home bills come out of your personal coins.
money.kw: money cash finance profit loss expense income invest withdraw budget debt bankrupt

tax.a: There is income tax, stamp tax and an accounting cost; shops also get electricity, water, gas and internet bills. The Accounting department shows a tax estimate.
tax.kw: tax income stamp accounting bill electricity water gas internet expense

speed.q: How do I change game speed?
speed.a: Use the ⏱ button on top for 0.5x–3x. Finance bars fast-forward 1–100 days; the OK / Next suggestions also speed things up.
speed.kw: speed fast slow day forward time calendar skip

ads.a: In Marketing pick a billboard, bus stop, bus or building ad. Creatives need admin approval, then show on the street and boost sales.
ads.kw: ads advertising billboard bus stop poster marketing promotion approval creative

vehicle.q: How do I get a vehicle?
vehicle.a: Buy or rent from the gallery; rentals show a time bar. Vehicles park in the car park and help with intercity trips.
vehicle.kw: vehicle car gallery rent rental parking park buy

travel.q: How do I travel to another city?
travel.a: Go to the street terminal and pick a city and transport (bus, own or rented vehicle). Ticket price and trip time depend on the city.
travel.kw: city travel terminal bus ticket trip istanbul ankara izmir another city

home.q: What can I do at home?
home.a: Enter your home: personal spending, bills, hobbies and self-development. Hobbies and study give level/XP; spending affects your quality of life.
home.kw: home house hobby bills personal development life quality energy happiness

chat.a: Talk to nearby players with text (Talk button). Commands: /sat, /yatir 100, /cek, /kur, /oneri, /sira. Use the emoji bar to react.
chat.kw: chat talk message command emoji friend player

quests.a: Daily quests give coins and XP. Badges (first company, sales, floors...) show on the 🏆 leaderboard and your profile.
quests.kw: quest badge achievement xp level rank reward daily leaderboard

save.a: Yes: a private token is stored in your browser; even after closing the tab you can press 'Resume' on the start screen. While you are away your company keeps selling at half speed.
save.kw: save resume continue exit offline afk return progress

pitch.a: In the Idea Box fill the business model canvas and prepare an investor pitch. In customer talks, right answers in a 3-round Q&A grow the sale.
pitch.kw: pitch investor idea canvas demo day customer roleplay persuade
